dataList.content:
Whoever your poor master is...
不管侍奉着什么人……
dataList.place:
Way Down to Tiekan Temple
通往铁槛寺之路

dataList.content:
... I can tell by the way their minions behave that they have no hope of ever taking that throne.
就这点水平，你们的主人肯定是与家主的位子无缘。

You'd be surprised by how much the lack of a just cause harms morale, fool!
一点都不堂堂正正，净整些龌龊之举，所以你们才会士气低下！
You're the one to talk! What just cause do you have? 那你们又有什么资格守住家主之位？

宽宏大量的势力成员

dataList.content:
Just how high-and-mighty is your—
你们有什么了不起的资格……

dataList.content:
Oi, shut it and listen. At least...
喂，至少我们……

... we actually want to change something about this place.
有谋求改变的意志。

I'd say we've a more just cause than you bastards whose only thought upon hearing that awful bell is 'how can I expand my real estate this time?'
这不比听到那该死的钟声就只想着让自己的房子变大的家伙好百倍啊？

dataList.content:
Both of you always speak with such conviction, Outis, Heathcliff.
奥提斯女士和希斯克利夫先生的发言总是很果断呢。

Hmph, gathering an army is the easy part.
哼，单纯地集结部队是很简单。

A leader's true qualities are revealed only when the time comes to actually lead their men!
但领袖的资质却会体现在其用兵之道中！

I see.
原来如此。

So it's your long experience with war that shaped your confidence, Outis.
看来是奥提斯女士久经沙场的经验带来了这种确信。

Because my life couldn't be any further from any battlefield of war.
我一直以来都过着和战争无缘的人生。

Or maybe I was always surrounded by wars, both large and small, in the Backstreets... and I was just sheltered from them.
说不定后巷里已经爆发过数场大大小小的战争了。

I've done nothing but watch from a distance, so I don't suppose I have any right to speak.
我作为旁观者，无话可说。

I wouldn't even know where I'd begin.
也不知道在这种场合该说什么。

This seemed like the perfect moment for Outis to brag about her experience, but she fell silent at that remark.
出乎意料的是，本以为会趾高气昂的奥提斯居然安静了下来。

There ain't anything too complicated about it, mate. If it's shite, it's shite. Don't think twice about it.
那有什么难的啊，心里不爽你就直说呗。

Like the lad does.
像他一样。

... Like me?
……我吗？

For a while, Sinclair continued to ask Heathcliff if he really was talking about him.
辛克莱持续反问希斯克利夫指的是不是自己。

I haven't ever walked down this hallway accompanied by so many other people...
大部分时候，都是我独自在这走廊中迈步……

I usually walked alone.
头一次有这么多人陪着我一起走。

Why? Didn'tcha take your servants with you?
怎么？不带点下人吗？

Sometimes, I did. Because I was scared to go there alone. But...
虽然我小时候因为害怕，会带着下人陪我一起来……

... I learned something as I grew older.
但我长大后渐渐明白了一些事。

It's that my heart is most at ease when walking down this road alone.
那就是，只有独自漫步，才是这里最能令我感到安心的事情。

I imagined Hong Lu, slowly walking down this hallway alone with a dark expression.
我想象了一下阴着一张脸，在这里独自漫步的鸿璐。

... It wasn't a pleasant sight.
……感觉不是很好。

Tiekan Temple...
铁槛寺……

I was the only one who was allowed to freely enter and exit. The Family Hierarch can technically be let inside, but...
只有我能随意进出。虽说家主也可以通行……

... even grandmother couldn't enter without their summon.
但哪怕是老太太，也得受到召唤才能进去。

W-wait, Jia Qiu wasn't being metaphorical?
还……还有这回事？我还以为贾丘先生只是打个比方而已……

So... why are they called the Xianren...? Are they actually some supernaturally enlightened blokes or something?
但是……为什么都管他们叫仙人啊？难不成真当上神仙了？

Yes. They endured the time of suffering, opened their eyes to the secret to freedom from aging and death, and eventually attained Enlightenment, earning themselves the exalted title of 'the Xianren'.
是的。他们都是历尽艰辛寻得长生不老之法、位列仙班之人。

But is that even... possible? What happened to them still searching for the answer to 'true immortality'?
那种事真的……有可能吗？不是说还没找到真正可以不老不死的方法吗？

Mate, you're bottlin' up again, and that makes me nervous... What the hell're we walkin' into?
唉，怎么又不说了，让人心里发毛……那里头到底有什么？

At least this place... feels much more tranquil than the world outside. It's quiet. And it smells nice, too.
但是……这里比外面安静。而且……好像还有什么好闻的香气。

I could almost forget that there's a war about to break out beyond the premises...
真不敢相信现在外面有好多势力剑拔弩张……

We're lucky.
我们很幸运。

Not many people know the actual path to reach Tiekan Temple.
知道去铁槛寺的路的人，在大观园也基本不存在。

But at least there's less chance of us running into any outside forces here.
至少……可以不用担心在这里遇到入侵大观园的外部势力了，不是么？

... Can we not with the foreshadowing?
……可别乌鸦嘴了。
